meta.note: Consumption figures are ANALYST ESTIMATES derived from sector, plant scale and MIBK intensity of the end-use process - not verified purchase data. The 'confidence' field grades them. Contact fields are intentionally EMPTY where unverified; run enrich.py to populate them. Never send an offer against an unverified contact.
meta.city_basis: Primary Brazilian plant or head-office location from public company information. Verify before use.
meta.cnpj_note: Add a 'cnpj' to any lead to unlock free Receita Federal enrichment via free_enrich.py --cnpj. Look CNPJs up at https://opencnpj.org.
meta.scope: Worldwide MIBK buyer list built for an India-based exporter. Priority A/B/C weighs freight distance from Indian ports, absence of domestic MIBK production, and order size. Distributors and trading houses rank high because they buy to resell and qualify fastest.
